title: Measured staircase template
purpose: Measure edge retention, tread and riser scale, drift, and vertical completeness.

deviceEnvironment.deviceModel: LiDAR-capable iPhone Pro; record exact identifier per run
deviceEnvironment.operatingSystem: iOS 18 or later; record exact build per run

lighting.description: Even stairwell illumination; record measured lux per run

orderedInstructions: Start at the lower landing with the first five steps visible.
Ascend slowly while sweeping both wall and tread edges.
Revisit at least three lower steps from above before finishing.

reference.uncertaintyNote: Record tread, riser, width, landing, and total-rise uncertainty before accepting a run.
